connector.name: Nzxplorer MCP
connector.registryDescription: NZX (New Zealand stock exchange) data: governance scores, financials, insider trades, boards
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.nzxplorer.co.nz over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package nzxplorer-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mambaventures account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: NZXPLORER_API_KEY
env.description: NZXplorer API key — free at https://nzxplorer.co.nz/developers. Unlocks the full 55-tool set; the remote URL above needs no key for 30 read-only tools.
